intro: People all over the world mark a space before a match. In Brazil, people stand in a circle. In England, boxers moved into a square with ropes. Fencers meet on a long, thin strip.
In this unit, you will meet these rooms. You will learn their names in many languages. You will hear how music can start a room. You will learn some laws and dates too.
By the end, you can name a room by its shape. You can tell where it comes from. You can tell one thing that happened to it in history.
bigQuestion: How does a shape on the floor, or a song, make a room for a match?

timeline.t: The Queensberry Rules ask for a 24-foot boxing ring
A law in Brazil makes capoeira a crime
Fencing is in the first modern Olympics
Mestre Bimba opens a capoeira school in Salvador
Judo joins the Olympics in Tokyo

words.d: the circle of people where capoeira happens
an Afro-Brazilian art that mixes game, music and movement
the round ring where sumo wrestlers meet
the place where a match happens; a boxing ring is a square
the long, thin strip where fencers meet
soft, thick floor mats used in Japanese rooms
a wooden bow with one metal string, used in capoeira music
ways of life, songs and crafts passed down to new people

test.q: What shape is a capoeira roda?
test.why: The roda is a circle of people.

test.q: What shape is a boxing ring?
test.why: A boxing ring is a square with ropes.
The piste is the strip where fencers meet.

test.q: Which sport meets in a dohyo?
test.why: Sumo wrestlers meet in the round dohyo.

test.q: What year did the Queensberry Rules come out?
test.why: The Queensberry Rules came out in England in 1867.

test.q: Which music maker is a bow with one string?
test.why: The berimbau is a wooden bow with one metal string.

test.q: What did a law in Brazil do in 1890?
test.why: The 1890 law made capoeira a crime.

test.q: What language are capoeira songs sung in?
test.why: Capoeira songs are sung in Portuguese.

test.q: Who honored the capoeira circle in 2014?
test.why: UNESCO added the capoeira circle to its heritage list in 2014.

write.prompt: Pick two rooms from this unit, like the roda and the boxing ring. Tell what shape each one is. Tell where it comes from. Use one date or rule from the unit, like the Queensberry Rules of 1867 or the 1890 law in Brazil.
tips: Name the room and its shape.
Name the place it comes from.
Use one real date from the unit.
Tell one way the two rooms are alike.
